The purpose of this lesson is to get to know each other and find out your learning goals. We will go through this step by step.

1) A brief introduction with the following information:
a) Who you are.
b) Where you are from.
c) Your background in learning English.
d) Your future goals and objectives for learning English including the type of lesson you want.

2) I will then teach you a few new things:
a) One new grammar point
b) Three new vocabulary words

3) We will finish the lesson by reviewing what you have learned and then set up plan to achieve your English language learning goals.

pro_course_detail.title: New English Vocabulary for Intermediate and Advanced Students
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson will focus on learning new Vocabulary through speaking and listening.

1) First I will introduce a new Topic or Theme and go over some of the key vocabulary and phrases with you. The topic could be something that interests you and that you might want to learn about. For instance "sports". Or if you wish I could choose a topic that would be relevant to your language learning goals.

2) We would then review the vocabulary and phrases you know about the topic. 

3) Then I will introduce some new key vocabulary and phrases, paying special attention to the pronunciation.

4) We would then talk about the topic either using conversation questions or a role play making sure we practice the relevant vocabulary and phrases

5) Ten minutes before the class finishes we review what you have learned and make sure I have corrected any mistakes or questions you might have.

6) I can give you some homework concerning that topic or another new topic that you would like to cover in the next class.

7) We schedule the next class to keep your English language learning on track.

Whether you're just starting with A1 or already advanced at C2, this class will help you improve your writing skills and gain confidence as an effective writer.

We’ll cover a range of topics and writing styles, including academic essays, creative writing, business writing, and more. Our focus will be on grammar, syntax, vocabulary, punctuation, and organising thoughts to craft compelling arguments. For beginners, we can start from the basics—even the English alphabet—with handwritten practice if needed.

You’ll have the chance to practise through various activities and homework assignments, such as short essays, journal entries, and other writing tasks. I will provide constructive feedback to help you refine your work and develop your own unique style.

With consistent practice, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to handle any writing task, from formal emails to university-level essays. If you wish to focus on proofreading, correction, or strengthening academic writing skills, I can guide you through areas of improvement in pieces you’ve written.

My goal is to help you become a fluent and confident writer, expressing yourself effectively in English. With practice you can achieve your goals, book a lesson with me to start!

**These lessons will enhance your overall accuracy in speaking, pronunciation, vocabulary, general fluency, and boost your confidence when speaking.**

If you want structured conversations or lack the confidence to speak freely in an unprepared way, these classes can help. They will develop your confidence, accuracy, and fluency in English. In these lessons, we’ll focus on areas you feel you need to work on, as well as those I identify through my evaluation of your level and ability in our first lesson and then in ongoing lessons.

We’ll work on speaking and listening skills, pronunciation (through drilling if you want/need), and how to speak in both planned and impromptu situations. Depending on your preference, I can offer either immediate or delayed correction. I will naturally introduce more challenging vocabulary and conversations as you progress, and I encourage active and engaged participation.

I offer lessons for all levels from A1 to C2. Lesson plans will be tailored in advance to make our classes efficient and aligned with your learning objectives. Homework will be provided if you’re a regular student.

At the end of each class, I’ll give you brief feedback, and after the lesson, I’ll send a detailed summary, including corrections, learning materials, vocabulary to practise, pronunciation tips, and any homework.

If that sounds like you, then this course is exactly what you need!

I'm a native Australian English speaker and teacher, and I’ve designed these classes to help you understand the vocabulary and pronunciation used by everyday Australians. I’ll also help you sound more like a native speaker from Straya!

My Australian English lessons cover everything from a basic introduction to Australian English, to its grammatical, lexical, vocabulary, and phonetic differences compared with Standard British or American English. I also offer classes on phonetics, vocabulary, colloquial expressions, idioms, and slang.

In each class, I’ll introduce and explain the key focus, and then we’ll practise using new vocabulary and expressions in conversation. The more classes you take, the more you’ll build your knowledge of Australian English.

At the end of each class, you'll receive a summary of the key information taught, the learning materials of that lesson, along with feedback on your performance and tips for improvement.

If you want to sound like a native Australian English speaker, or simply understand them better, I invite you to join these lessons.
